description:
✅ What is the 126710BLNR “Batgirl”

	•	The 126710BLNR belongs to the Rolex GMT-Master II family.  ￼

	•	The “Batgirl” nickname comes from its black-and-blue “Cerachrom” bezel (same color scheme as the “Batman” variant) + its five-link Jubilee bracelet — the bracelet style gives it a slightly dressier, more refined look than the original Oyster-bracelet “Batman”.  ￼

	•	It’s a 40 mm watch (case diameter).  ￼



🛠️ Build, Materials & Design

	•	Case: Made in Rolex’s proprietary stainless steel (Oystersteel) — robust, corrosion-resistant, and polished/finished according to Rolex standards.  ￼

	•	Bezel: Bidirectional rotatable 24-hour bezel with a blue-and-black Cerachrom insert — the signature “Batman/Batgirl” look. The ceramic is durable and resistant to scratches and fading.  ￼

	•	Crystal: Sapphire crystal, with a Cyclops lens over the date at 3 o’clock for easy reading.  ￼

	•	Bracelet: The “Jubilee” five-piece link bracelet — considered more elegant and refined than the sportier Oyster bracelet. It uses a folding Oysterlock clasp + often includes the EasyLink comfort extension.  ￼

	•	Water-resistance: 100 meters (330 ft)—suitable for everyday wear, including splashes, rain, or swimming (though it remains a luxury sports/travel watch, not a diver).  ￼



⏱️ Movement & Functions

	•	Movement: In-house Rolex Caliber 3285 — automatic, self-winding, with Rolex’s modern technology (Parachrom hairspring, Paraflex shock absorbers, etc.).  ￼

	•	Power reserve: ~ 70 hours.  ￼

	•	Functions:

	•	Hours, minutes, seconds

	•	Date at 3 o’clock (with Cyclops magnifier)  ￼

	•	GMT / 2nd time-zone function: a dedicated 24-hour hand + rotating 24-hour bezel — lets you track a second (or even third) time zone, a hallmark of the GMT-Master II line.  ￼

	•	Precision: Certified by Rolex as a Superlative Chronometer, with accuracy ≈ –2/+2 sec/day (after casing).  ￼



🎨 Dial, Style & Vibe

	•	Dial: Black dial with luminous hour markers (and hands) framed in white gold (or similar), and luminous elements for legibility in low light.  ￼

	•	Bezel color combo: The black-and-blue bezel is as much a style statement as a functional element. It’s instantly recognizable, giving the watch a sporty-but-refined presence.

	•	Bracelet + case finish: The Jubilee bracelet softens the sportiness — on the wrist, the watch balances between a professional traveler’s tool and a luxury everyday timepiece.

	•	Overall vibe: Versatile. It works with casual outfits, business attire, and even more formal wear. It’s not overly flashy, but its heritage, design, and quality make it a statement piece on the wrist.



🎯 What Makes the Batgirl (126710BLNR) Stand Out

	•	GMT function + dual-time capability — ideal for travelers or anyone needing to track multiple time zones.

	•	Iconic aesthetic — the black-and-blue Cerachrom bezel is iconic in the Rolex world; with the Jubilee bracelet, it offers a slightly more dressy, versatile interpretation than bracelet-sport-only Rolex.

	•	Modern movement and technology — the 3285 movement brings long power reserve, robustness, and precision, making it built for real-world daily wear, not just occasional use.

	•	Balance of sportiness and elegance — because of the design and materials, the 126710BLNR (Batgirl) bridges the gap between a rugged sports watch and a refined everyday luxury watch.

	•	Collector desirability — among fans and collectors, this reference enjoys high demand: its combination of heritage, design, and functionality has made it one of the most sought-after modern Rolex GMTs.  ￼

Trades

All purchases are subject to the sales tax rate of your shipping address.





Returns
